correctness.rationale: Independent re-execution and re-derivation both pass. VERIFY_OK replayed via shipped verify.py and via an independent from-scratch recomputation: all 19 stored laws satisfy skew, all-triple-vanishing ([[.,.]_a,.]_b=0 for all a,b, which implies Jacobi and mixed Jacobi in the 2-step case), and centre/derived dims exactly as tabled (abelian (5,0); k=3 F-samples (3,1), H (3,2); k=2 L2/K/J/E-samples (2,2), M (2,1)). Central-extension reduction is sound: 2-step implies triple products vanish so Jacobi/mixed-Jacobi automatic; D subset Z; Q=V/Z abelian; B^2=0; shear Hom(Q,Z) acts trivially so Aut-orbits = GL(Q)xGL(Z)-orbits on Alt^2(Q,Z) pairs. Centre lemma: dimQ=1 forces abelian (k=5), hence k=4 impossible; k=0 excluded by the same D-subset-Z argument (omitted one-liner, trivial). k=3 orbit analysis verified: Alt^2 of 2-dim Q is 1-dim with det-scale; rank-0 abelian, rank-1 line plus P1 ratio [a:b] invariant under common scalar+common GL3 (no bracket mixing for ordered isomorphisms), rank-2 single orbit H via GL3 transitivity on 2-planes. k=2 wedge-surjectivity verified: for 3x3, /\^2 S = det(S)(S^-1)^T, so /\^2|_SL3 is the inverse-transpose automorphism (onto SL3) and scalars dI=/\^2(sqrt(d)I) exist as F alg-closed; hence column action covers all of GL3 and orbits = Kronecker strict-equivalence classes. Faithful condition verified: right kernel dim>=2 contains (hence equals, Gr(2,3)~P2) some q/\Q, centralising a lift; dim<=1 centralises nothing, so centre stays 2. Kronecker list checked against stored pencils: L2 (gcd 1, always rank 2), K=L1+J1 (linear gcd, min-rank 1), M=L1+zero (derived 1), J=J2+L0 incl. N2+L0 at infinity (squared-linear gcd, min-rank 1), E=regular-2x2+zero column over Sym^2P1=P2 incl. J1+N1/N1+N1 points and scalar points (split/squared gcd, E-distinct two rank-1 points vs E-scalar min-rank 0) separate as claimed; unfaithful L1^T+zeros and zero pencil correctly fall in k=3 stratum. Minor-gcd/min-rank/eigenvalue separation recomputed on stored pencils and matches. Random-pencil spot check is only a spot check, not a completeness proof; completeness rests on Kronecker's theorem (Gantmacher XII) cited explicitly, which is proof not experiment. Limitations (k=1 4x4 pencils, class>=3, ordered pairs, alg-closed char!=2) honestly stated and match the mathematics.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/search alone. Nearest algebraic prior Ladra-Leite da Cunha-Lopes arXiv:2406.04036 (v2 Nov 2024) proves the extended Skjelbred-Sund machine but closes only dims <=4 (dim3: 3 classes+1-family; dim4: 12+6xP1+2xP2 pre-correction, still dim<=4 after 2025 correction); it is the base/method, not the dim-5 list. Nearest geometric prior Abdurasulov et al. arXiv:2506.05353 gives only complex 4-dim degeneration classification, no dim-5 algebraic types/orbits. Live arXiv full-text search 'nilpotent compatible Lie algebras classification' returns 7 hits, none above dim 4 (2 unrelated metric-geometry senses); no dim-5 compatible census is indexed. Classical Kronecker theory (Gantmacher) classifies 2x3 pencils up to strict equivalence but states no compatible-algebra theorem: the wedge-surjectivity identification (orbits = strict classes), the faithful-locus = centre-2 condition via q/\Q, and the ordered-pair F(P1)+H / L2,M,K(P1),J(P1),E(P2) dictionary with explicit compatible laws are not in Kronecker nor in either prior paper. No journal/thesis dim-5 list was found; the result is a new boundary advance, not a rename, parameter substitution, transcription (no dim-5 list exists to transcribe), or mechanical implication of dim-4 data.

value.rationale: Headline judged separately from the unfinished full dim-5 census: the centre>=2 2-step stratum (k=3: F over P1 + discrete H; k=2: discretes L2,M + families K/J over P1 + E over Sym^2P1=P2; plus abelian) is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object (2-step nilpotent compatible pairs in dim 5) motivated before computation (bi-Hamiltonian/Poisson-pencil and compatible-deformation programme of Ladra et al.; Skjelbred-Sund extension; solvable/filiform follow-ups cite need for explicit laws). The value was not known or mechanically implied (family collapsing and faithful locus unknown in advance), and a future researcher can reasonably need the precise representatives, counts, and separating invariants (k, derived dim, minor-gcd/min-rank, eigenvalue multiset). It is not a textbook restatement (no textbook states this dictionary), mere substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration: every type has an integer law, certificate, and invariant separation. Incompleteness (k=1 wild 4x4 pencils, class>=3) is disclosed honestly and does not erase the headline; ordered-only quotienting is stated. Certification alone is not the value — the new exact dictionary is.

Verified faithful-locus logic: 2-planes in /\^2Q are q/\Q, so right-kernel dim>=2 centralises a lift, dim<=1 does not.
